sources.title: Function Calling - Qwen
sources.snippet: As function calling is essentially implemented using prompt engineering, you could manually construct the model inputs for Qwen3 models. However, frameworks with function calling support can help you with all that laborious work. In the following, we will introduce the usage (via dedicated function calling chat template) with Qwen-Agent, vLLM.
